title: Runtime Verification of Multiple Natural Language Criteria for Agent Governance
abstract: arXiv:2611.23074v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI agents are governed by hundreds of natural language criteria, yet existing verifiers cannot efficiently evaluate an agent's output against a large set of such criteria and report which are satisfied, violated, or inapplicable. We introduce the VFM, a tree-attention verifier that encodes the shared context and target text, and scores N natural language criteria in parallel, returning independent per-criterion ternary verdicts. The VFM is pretrained on CriteriaBank, a corpus of 394K (context, target, criterion, verdict) tuples spanning over 321K distinct criterion strings. A finetuned VFM-4B outperforms GPT-5.4 on a synthetic governance benchmark. On the DynaBench multi-criterion benchmark, it outperforms DynaGuard-4B on trace-level failure detection, and its per-criterion verdicts localize the violated rule and support focused escalation to a larger chain-of-thought judge. translated_title: 面向智能体治理的多条自然语言准则运行时验证
translated_abstract: AI智能体受数百条自然语言准则的约束，然而现有的验证器无法高效地将智能体的输出与大量此类准则进行比对评估，并报告哪些准则被满足、被违反或不适用。我们提出了VFM，一种树注意力验证器，它对共享上下文和目标文本进行编码，并行地对N条自然语言准则进行评分，返回相互独立的逐准则三元判定结果。VFM在CriteriaBank语料库上进行了预训练，该语料库包含394K个（上下文、目标、准则、判定）元组，涵盖超过321K条不同的准则字符串。经微调的VFM-4B在一个合成治理基准上优于GPT-5.4。在DynaBench多准则基准上，它在轨迹级失败检测方面优于DynaGuard-4B，并且其逐准则判定结果能够定位被违反的规则，支持将问题聚焦升级至更大的思维链评判器。我们证明CriteriaBank预训练可以提升跨域（泛化能力）。
tldr: 提出了一种基于树注意力的并行验证器VFM，可在运行时对智能体输出同时评估数百条自然语言治理准则并给出逐条三元判定，其预训练语料库CriteriaBank带来了跨域性能提升。
en_tdlr: A tree-attention verifier called VFM that evaluates an agent's output against hundreds of natural language governance criteria in parallel, returning per-criterion ternary verdicts, with CriteriaBank pretraining improving cross-domain performance.
